faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MMMUT SRA recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Senior Research Assistant (SRA) post is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. or an equivalent degree with First Class to be eligible for the Senior Research Assistant (SRA) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Assistant (SRA) post is 32 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the SRA position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Research Assistant (SRA) post will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates are advised to prepare accordingly.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Research Assistant (SRA) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 28,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications for the MMMUT Senior Research Assistant (SRA) recruitment must be submitted in offline mode by post.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology located?
faq.answer: Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology is located in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 273010.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is MMMUT/CESD/R&D/........

faq.question: Q10. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Research Assistant (SRA) position is scheduled to be held on 30th September 2026.
